image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a converted van chassis) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a two-tone paint scheme with a red roof and front section, and lime green sides with maroon lower panels. It has a large windshield, side windows, and visible text/numbers on the windshield and license plate area.
